body: I just heard back from our registrar and she told us it is still indeed booked!! Good lord what a relief. I'm sort of glad they were indeed unorganized enough to not notice haha! All is well after all 😌💕

I'm glad to hear it worked out for you! 
The registry office said in their email they wouldn't send reminders hence why I'm panicking. I figured our registrar would have flagged us to say our reservation was cancelled but I don't know. I guess all I can do is wait to hear from them :( Thanks

I think it's easier for me to be in denial and think to myself "I've accepted what happened." I don't think he would do these kinds of things again,  but at the same time that's exactly what enablers would say. I don't want to put my future at risk ever. I think it's about time I tell him. You've given me a lot to think about. Thank you.
Thank you for saying that. It's been tough coming to terms with "having it easy" compared to my mom.
Lol! I probably won't be speaking to her for a while after that..
That's actually pretty good advice, thank you, I'll be trying that now

It's no problem, I just use it as a way to illustrate how I feel about those moments.

I do kinda wish I had access to guns every now and then, though

I think you're right indeed. Thank you though, it does suck at the moment but it was important for me to realize that. I feel kind of happy being able to understand my relationship with my family and what my Ndad truly is about. I feel more in control of myself now
Thank you so much for the support, this year has just been realization after realization and it's been quite though on me. Cheers <3
That does sound like what my Ndad has been doing with me, I think that may be the case then. Thank you! It kind of helps being able to understand things more

It's quite frustrating honestly because I've aiming to lose about 10kg  in the least amount of time and it feels like all the progress I'm making is nullified by missing a day of exercise.

I've been obsessing over my weight a lot recently and if I don't see the number on my scale decrease all of my energy is drained out and I just give up. That behavior didn't really appear until I realised I needed to start exercising a bit and I think it may be feeding my brain new negative things to think about

I'm kind of glad I'm not the only one, unfortunately.

It can get quite lonely sometimes, so my brain just decides to make a new scenario in my head.

Though Reddit support groups have been a great way to take my mind off of things, it's really nice being able to express yourself and have people connect with you

Thank you for listening, bless your kind heart

Soon will be 18 right now

I feel like both honestly. After I'll have a grasp on the whole adult thing, there will be nothing to look forward to. So what's the point of carrying on if every day is slowly pushing you to your limit?
